## How I would narrow the shortlist

| Your primary requirement | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| Global, enterprise-wide transformation | Accenture, Deloitte, NTT DATA |
| Snowflake or modern cloud warehouse implementation | Slalom, Analytics8, N-iX |
| Complex custom engineering and pipelines | EPAM Systems, N-iX |
| Tailored warehouse development and BI | ScienceSoft, Analytics8 |
| Strict governance and regulatory requirements | Deloitte, Accenture |


These are initial-fit recommendations, not verified rankings of delivery quality or price. Confirm each firm's current platform certifications, comparable client references, and experience with your specific industry before selecting a partner.
